model_selection_status: Exact SHA256 of official registry manifest bytes captured in GitHub Actions run41664725390; raw bytes retained in model lock. Actual Ollama pull digest, CPU placement and model metadata must match before inference.
development_selection_rule: Reuse all sixteen preregistered v3 development IDs, two per family. Initial diagnostic pilot takes the first opaque ID in each damage, identity, duplicate and delay family within that fixed development subset. Restore the complete sixteen before freeze.
held_out_selection_rule: From registered held-out cases exclude both registered.model_subset and v3.held_out_case_ids. Within each family rank SHA256 UTF-8(seed + NUL + held-out + NUL + family + NUL + fixture_id), tie-break fixture_id ordinally, take two per family, then sort the final sixteen IDs ordinally.
held_out_selection_source: eval/plans/registered.json and eval/plans/model-experiment-v3.json metadata only; no evaluator truth or model outcome filtering.
hypothesis: A larger verified open model will more reliably complete the three-tool protocol and choose policy-supported actions than the published qwen3:0.6b agent. The model remains responsible for action, retrieval query and citation choices; code retains scoped observations, derives integer cents and independently validates proposals.

preserved_results.note: Original CPU subset; preserve original manifests and failures.
Frozen v3 and its failed quality status remain unchanged; v4 uses a different held-out subset.

unchanged_authority: No model approval or execution capability.
Exact observed version snapshots remain bound to the active case and run.
Only actually retrieved versioned clauses may be cited.
The existing deterministic validator derives USD cents and rejects unsupported or stale proposals.
Evaluator truth is never imported into agent or application code.
All effects and messages remain synthetic; no provider connection.
held_out_rule: No v4 held-out inference before complete matched development records meet the declared acceptance rule and the model, tool interface, budgets, selected IDs, source hashes and configuration are committed and frozen. Run the reserved held-out set once. Do not tune or retry the operating point using its results. Reproductions must be labeled repeated, never fresh scores.
failure_retention_rule: Retain every model run, missing output, invalid proposal, timeout and infrastructure failure with original provenance. An incomplete development run cannot pass freeze. A pre-inference startup failure is infrastructure evidence, not an invented model-quality score.
comparison_limits: V4 and prior held-out runs use different case subsets; do not claim a paired held-out before/after improvement.
The fresh subset shares the existing held-out family template lineages; it is not a new-template benchmark.
CPU hardware and runtime metadata must be reported for each run; differences are not automatically attributable solely to model size.
No proposal is approved or executed during model evaluation, so model effect safety is not evaluated.

prior_attempts.note: All four stored proposals were correct, but a review-table column mismatch prevented independent approval/effect counts. Not eligible for freeze.

changes_from_v3: Larger pinned Qwen3:4b Q4_K_M open CPU model; original 0.6b weights and all v3 sources/results preserved.
Independent agent-v4 project with exact synthetic fixture copies verified against root data.
Internal random case UUID omitted from model prompt; trusted scope remains code-bound.
Same three tool capabilities, observed snapshots, validator and case budgets.
Independent authority audit joins reviews through proposals and counts both monetary effects and draft dispositions.
